The '''Kem Stor Ai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tennuutta sector/Legends|Tennuutta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kem Stor Ai]].
